subject: Runtime KV/Batching Team - approval to open 2 infra/runtime reqs
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: add 2 hires to runtime/infra (KV cache + batching)

Hi team,

Following our Q2 roadmap review, I'm requesting approval to open two headcount reqs focused on runtime/infra:

- Role A: Senior Software Engineer, Runtime — focus on KV cache, prefix caching, and reducing tail latency. Target level: L6 preferred (can backfill as L5 if timing dictates).
- Role B: Software Engineer, Infra — focus on batching/throughput optimizations, autoscaling integration. Target level: L5.

Why now:
- We have three strategic customers onboarding in May that will increase 99th percentile token throughput by ~2.5x.
- Known risk: KV cache eviction churn and tail latency under medium-sized bursts. We need dedicated ownership to avoid regressions.

Proposed compensation bands (initial ask for budgeting):
- L5 Infra: Base $160,000–$190,000; Total comp range $200k–$240k (including equity/bonus).
- L6 Infra: Base $195,000–$235,000; Total comp range $260k–$320k.

Attached is a short req packet with JD bullets and an estimate of onboarding timeline (req_packet_v2.pdf).

Request: approval to open two reqs (one L6, one L5) and confirmation of budget/CC so recruiting can post. Target start window: late June — early July.

If approved I'll loop TalentBridge to run an initial search and will post the reqs in Greenhouse once terms are finalized.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add 2 hires to runtime/infra (KV cache + batching)

Thanks Tessa — this looks reasonable. A few notes from People Ops on comp and process: 

- Market guidance (SF Bay Area, engineering infra roles):
  • L5 (Senior SWE): Base $160k–$190k; typical total cash (base+bonus) 175k–205k; expected equity: 0.10%–0.25% depending on level/experience.
  • L6 (Senior+ / Staff SWE): Base $195k–$235k; total cash 220k–270k; expected equity: 0.25%–0.55%.

- We prefer to authorize the reqs as: 1 x L6 flex-to-L5; 1 x L5. If you want both L6 we need a short justification for the business impact (scarcity is valid but should be budgeted).
- Please include a finalized JD and the final band you're planning to offer before you create the reqs — People Ops will sign off on offers.

I'll also attach the updated headcount packet template for finance (REQ_PACKET_V2). Posting note: People Ops can approve offers within the bands above; anything above the top of band requires VP sign-off.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add 2 hires to runtime/infra (KV cache + batching)

Tessa — thanks for the clear ask and packet. I approve opening both reqs in principle with these caveats: 

1) Make one req explicitly L6 (senior/lead level) and one L5. We should prioritize the L6 for KV cache ownership. If recruiting surfaces a very strong L5 we can consider pushing them into the L6 slot but only if Monica signs off on comp incremental.
2) Tighten the JD to focus on shipping measurable latency/run-rate improvements (KPIs: reduce 99p latency by X ms at baseline Y and improve tokens-per-GPU by Z%). Concrete goals will help with candidate selection and interview calibration.
3) Please coordinate with Sean to confirm cost center and OTE impact. I don't want to exceed our Q2 hiring spend plan.

Assuming those lines are satisfied, you have my go-ahead to open the reqs and engage TalentBridge. Please iterate the JD then post.

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure & Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add 2 hires to runtime/infra (KV cache + batching)

Tessa / Markus — finance side: we can absorb these two hires under Infra cost center CC-4302 within the Q2 headcount plan provided the hires start before Aug 1 and we don't exceed the top-of-band comp materially.

Estimated incremental run-rate (annualized):
- If hired at mid-band: L6 total comp ~$285k, L5 total comp ~$220k -> combined run-rate delta ~ $505k/year (benefits and taxes ~ additional 8%).
- Monthly run-rate delta ≈ $42k.

I've attached a one-line budget file with the cost-center code (headcount_budget_line.xlsx). Please confirm the planned start dates (we'll mark the hires in the hiring forecast). If you plan to push the L6 above $300k total comp, escalate to Markus for final sign-off.

Approved contingent on: start dates within FY Q3 window and final JDs posted to Greenhouse with bands attached.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>, TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiter@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: add 2 hires to runtime/infra (KV cache + batching)

Thanks everyone — good to have alignment. Summary and next steps: 

1) Approvals: Markus (in principle) and Sean (budget contingent on start dates) — Monica confirmed band guidance and sign-off workflow.
2) Final req plan: 1 x L6 (KV cache owner), 1 x L5 (batching/throughput). I'll tighten the JD to include measurable KPIs and post both to Greenhouse by EOD Wed (22 Apr).
3) Recruiting: looping in TalentBridge (recruiter@talentbridge.com) to start slates when the reqs go live. TalentBridge — please prepare an initial candidate slate within 10 business days of posting; target interview loop length 3–4 weeks.
4) Budget: Sean — I'll provide expected start dates when we have offers, aiming for hires to start between Jun 22–Jul 20.

Attachments: req_packet_v2.pdf (JD bullets); headcount_budget_line.xlsx (finance).

I'll follow up with the Greenhouse links and the interview rubric once the JD is finalized.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Staff Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
